name: short-05-the-silence
notes: BATCH-01 script #16. PSYCH pillar. Hook: contradiction. Contains a real four-second silence.

scenes.text: The best thing to say after your ask is nothing.
scenes.vo: The best thing you can say after your ask is nothing. For four full seconds.
Here's what four actually feels like. Don't skip.
Uncomfortable, right? That discomfort is the entire mechanism.

scenes.text: Filling it undoes the ask. You negotiate against yourself.
scenes.vo: Filling that silence undoes your ask. You start negotiating against yourself before they've said a word.

scenes.label: THE RULE
scenes.text: After the ask, whoever speaks first loses. Let it be them.
scenes.vo: After the ask, whoever speaks first loses. Let it be them.
